Mutation fixture (lane mrental), predicted by hand from the archived sources before running the evaluator. Pub. 527 (2025) pp. 25-26, Dividing Expenses: a day rented at a fair price is a rental day even if also used personally, so total use is 190 fair days + 12 personal days - 2 days that were both = 200 days, and the rental part is 190/200 = 0.95 (six places 0.950000). Dwelling Unit Used as a Home (p. 26): 12 personal days is not more than 14, so it is not used as a home and the expenses are divided (p. 28, Not used as a home). Each shared cost times 0.95: cleaning 1,000 -> 950.00; insurance 1,200 -> 1,140.00; legal 800 -> 760.00; mortgage 6,000 -> 5,700.00; other interest 400 -> 380.00; repairs 1,500 -> 1,425.00; supplies 300 -> 285.00; taxes 2,000 -> 1,900.00; utilities 1,100 -> 1,045.00; other 500 -> 475.00. No advertising, commissions or management fees were paid, so lines 5, 8 and 11 are 0 (whether rental-only costs are divided is not tested here). No depreciation. Line 20 14,060.00; line 21 = 20,000 - 14,060 = 5,940.00 (i1040se line 21), Schedule E line 24 5,940.00.

Mutation fixture (lane mrental), predicted by hand from the archived sources before running the evaluator. Pub. 527 (2025) pp. 25-26, Dividing Expenses: every personal-use day of rentals a and b was also a fair rental day (a: 5 of 5, b: 12 of 12), and such a day counts as a rental day, so total use is 100 days, all rental: the rental part is 100/100 = 1 and nothing is cut. Neither is used as a home (5 and 12 personal days, not more than 14; p. 26). Rental c has no personal use, so nothing is divided (i1040se p. 5, line 2). Since the rental part is 1 or there is no personal use, the result does not depend on whether costs of the rental alone are divided by days. a: advertising 1,000, commissions 600, management 800, no cleaning or legal fees: line 20 2,400.00, line 21 7,600.00. b: advertising 1,000: line 21 9,000.00. c: advertising 1,000, cleaning 700, commissions 600, legal 450, management 800: line 20 3,550.00, line 21 6,450.00. Schedule E line 24 = 7,600 + 9,000 + 6,450 = 23,050.00.
